-- Check store names to find Hyvinkää
SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name, is_current
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Hyvink%' AND is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY store_name

SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
WHERE category LIKE '%Clean%' AND is_current = TRUE

SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, valid_from, valid_to
FROM dim_store

calls.statement:
-- Get units sold of Cleaning & Household products at Hyvinkää in P5
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 107
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning & Household'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-08-25' AND '2025-09-21'
